purpose: Construct or boundedly fail to construct an explicit nonhomothetic algebraic phase curve on the planar Newtonian three-body common level (H,C)=(0,0), using a finite exact rational/Puiseux graph search in the arbitrary-mass rectilinear reduction.
claim_boundary: A QUALIFIED_WITNESS certifies only one W1-W12 algebraic phase curve and does not itself prove a differential-Galois obstruction. A COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT certifies only exhaustion of the 11,700 locked graph ideals and does not prove that no suitable orbit exists.

target_model.system: Full planar Newtonian three-body problem after center-of-mass reduction, restricted only for discovery to an ordered collision-free collinear chamber.
target_model.mass_domain: m1,m2,m3 are finite and strictly positive; common scaling is immaterial but no mass is set to zero.
target_model.physical_dense_open: r!=0, x!=0, x!=1, every declared cover denominator is nonzero, and u is not identically zero.
target_model.promotion_scope: A sentinel or special-mass graph is not sufficient. Promotion requires exact arbitrary-positive-mass continuation or a finite exhaustive branch proof.

preexisting_qualified_facts.v1_endpoint: WP6-DZ-FEAS-v1 is a signed COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT and prohibits opening WP6-DZ-MR-v1 from its evidence.
preexisting_qualified_facts.known_failure: The parabolic Euler-Moulton and Lagrange curves are algebraic H=C=0 solutions but are homothetic and obstruction-free at all variational orders used by the pinned analysis.
preexisting_qualified_facts.constructive_gap: The arbitrary-mass rectilinear zero-level flow contains nonhomothetic trajectories but v1 found no identified algebraic physical phase curve.
preexisting_qualified_facts.nonzero_level_boundary: WP6-COMMON-v1 already qualifies the restricted rational nonintegrability claim on every finite real common level except (0,0).

witness_requirements.W1: The candidate solves the full planar Newtonian three-body equations exactly on a nonempty open part of its phase curve.
witness_requirements.W2: The candidate is valid for arbitrary finite positive masses or belongs to a finite set of branches proved exhaustive over that mass domain.
witness_requirements.W3: The candidate is nonstationary and is not merely a known homothetic central-configuration solution.
witness_requirements.W4: The candidate satisfies H=0 and C=0 identically by exact symbolic calculation.
witness_requirements.W5: The orbit is an algebraic phase curve over an explicitly declared differential base field.
witness_requirements.W6: The algebraic-distance variables and every denominator are valid on a nonempty dense open subset of the phase curve.
witness_requirements.W7: The gradients of H and C are independent at a generic point of the candidate.
witness_requirements.W8: An exact tangent common-level VE can be derived and the flow, classical-integral, symmetry, and gauge directions can be separated.
witness_requirements.W9: At least one nontrivial NVE block has rational or algebraic coefficients over the declared base field and is not the known obstruction-free homothetic equation.
witness_requirements.W10: The analyzed open curve avoids collision singularities, or an exact meromorphic regularization and physical pullback are proved.
witness_requirements.W11: A source-disjoint exact implementation reproduces the orbit equations, H=C=0, generic regularity, and NVE coefficient data.
witness_requirements.W12: Every derivation input and generated artifact has immutable provenance, and the independent reference imports no production implementation.

required_outputs: qualification lock, result, signed record, and human-readable report
adversarial_controls: Reject u identically zero and every constant-shape Euler-Moulton branch from the graph search.
Reject m_i=0 restricted or two-body degenerations.
Reject graphs that satisfy the vector field but not the exact zero-energy polynomial.
Reject graphs supported only at x=0, x=1, r=0, or a cover pole.
Reject a sentinel-only or special-mass graph as satisfying W2.
Reject numerical residuals, floating coefficients, interpolation-only identities, and approximate Groebner decisions.
Treat every timeout, resource abort, malformed ideal, or positive-dimensional unresolved branch as INCOMPLETE unless it is explicitly represented and audited.
Reject opening WP6-DZ-MR-v1 from COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT or INCOMPLETE.

decision_policy.QUALIFIED_WITNESS: At least one frozen candidate passes W1-W12, all 11,700 search systems through its discovery index are decided, and all integrity and adversarial controls pass.
decision_policy.COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT: All 11,700 locked coefficient ideals are exactly decided, every non-unit ideal is represented and audited, no candidate passes W1-W12, and all derivation, provenance, and adversarial controls pass.
decision_policy.INCOMPLETE: Any frozen input changes, any system is not exactly decided, any non-unit ideal is unaudited, or any required control, prerequisite, reproduction, or provenance check fails.
decision_policy.MR_PROMOTION_RULE: Create WP6-DZ-MR-v1 only when the signed v2 record status is QUALIFIED_WITNESS and names exactly one frozen full-system witness payload. Every other status prohibits promotion.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_NULL_CLAIM: Within the four locked shape covers, exact one- and two-term Laurent supports with exponents -2 through 2, and thirteen exact mass/order sentinels, WP6-DZ-FEAS-v2 found no graph that extends to a W1-W12 arbitrary-positive-mass witness.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_NONEXISTENCE_CLAIM: No explicit nonhomothetic algebraic H=C=0 orbit exists.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_NONINTEGRABILITY_CLAIM: The planar Newtonian three-body problem is nonintegrable on (H,C)=(0,0).
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_MR_CLAIM: A Morales-Ramis or Ziglin obstruction has been proved on the double-zero level.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SPECIAL_MASS_PROMOTION: A graph at one sentinel or special mass proves the arbitrary-positive-mass claim.

stop_rule.success_stop: Stop only after one candidate is extended and frozen as an arbitrary-positive-mass W1-W12 witness.
stop_rule.null_stop: Return COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT only after all 11,700 ideals and every non-unit branch are exactly decided and audited.
stop_rule.no_scope_extension: Do not add covers, exponents, support terms, mass sentinels, coefficient fields, or compute budget after seeing results. Any extension requires WP6-DZ-FEAS-v3.

invalidation: Discovery or search implementation existed before the specification lock.
Any v1 or WP6-COMMON frozen prerequisite changed.
A floating or probabilistic decision was treated as exact.
A system was omitted, retried with a changed ansatz, or silently timed out.
A candidate was promoted without arbitrary-positive-mass W1-W12 qualification.
WP6-DZ-MR-v1 was created without the required signed success record.
